# UX Design: Ultron Dashboard Improvement

**Generated by:** Experience Designer persona (Aitri pre-planning)
**Date:** 2026-03-03
**Status:** Ready for Architect

---

## 1. Hero Flow — Zero-Friction Primary Path

**Goal:** Admin opens dashboard, assesses system health, acts on any issue — in under 10 seconds.

```
1. Page load
   └─ Header: global alert indicator visible (red dot if active, muted if clear)
   └─ Metric tiles: 5 tiles above fold — each shows % + absolute value + color state
   └─ No action required for healthy state → task complete in <5s

2. Alert active
   └─ Header badge: amber/red dot with count visible from ANY page
   └─ Admin clicks badge → navigates to /alerts
   └─ Alert list shows actionable items

3. Settings adjustment
   └─ Admin navigates to /settings
   └─ Section nav bar at top (sticky): Backup | Telegram | Alerts | Hardware | Security | System
   └─ Admin clicks section → jumps to anchor, no blind scrolling
   └─ Makes change, saves inline → returns to dashboard via sidebar or browser back
```

Every step above has a recovery path. No dead ends.

---

## 2. Component Innovation — Differentiated Interaction

**Metric tile with contextual sparkline hint**

Current: tiles show a large number. Proposed: add a 3-value micro-trend indicator below the absolute value — not a full chart, just 3 colored dots representing the last 3 SSE readings (green/yellow/red progression). This gives trend signal without adding a chart element.

```
┌─────────────────────┐
│ CPU                 │
│ 23.4%               │  ← large accent number
│ ● ● ●               │  ← micro-trend: 3 dots (color = threshold state)
└─────────────────────┘
```

**Why this is different:** no extra data fetching, no chart library, uses existing ring buffer data already in SSE payload. Purely additive template change.

> Note: if SSE payload does not include historical readings in the metrics event, micro-trend is deferred to Phase 2. The dot indicators fall back to a single static dot showing current state only.

---

## 3. State Matrix

### Dashboard — Metric Tiles

| State | CPU Tile | RAM Tile | Temp Tile |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Ideal** | `23.4%` accent, absolute `1.1 GHz`, 3 green dots | `45% / 1.8 GB / 4 GB` accent | `52°C` green, micro-trend green |
| **Warning (75–90%)** | `78.1%` warning amber, absolute, dots amber | same pattern | `72°C` amber |
| **Critical (>90%)** | `94.2%` danger red, pulsing border, dots red | same | `82°C` red |
| **No data** | `--` muted, no dots | `--` muted | `--` muted |
| **SSE disconnected** | "Collecting data..." text, static tile | same | same |

### Global Alert Indicator (Header)

| State | Appearance |
|---|---|
| **No active alerts** | Dot hidden or muted gray |
| **1+ active alerts** | Amber dot with count badge, visible in header across all pages |
| **Critical alert** | Red pulsing dot |
| **SSE disconnected** | Indicator hidden (fallback: sidebar badge still works if page was hydrated) |

### Settings Page

| State | Appearance |
|---|---|
| **Ideal** | Section nav bar visible at top, user jumps to section, no scroll needed |
| **Section saving** | Inline save button shows spinner, disabled state, success checkmark after |
| **Save error** | Inline error message under the section form, no page reload |
| **Mobile** | Section nav collapses to a `<select>` or horizontally scrollable pill row |

### Mobile Sidebar

| State | Appearance |
|---|---|
| **Closed** | Hamburger button in header, sidebar off-screen |
| **Open** | Sidebar slides in, overlay covers content, tap-outside closes |
| **Active page** | Nav item has accent border + background, distinguishable even at 44px height |
| **Alert active** | Alert nav item shows red dot regardless of sidebar collapsed/open state |

## 4. Accessibility and Inclusivity Audit

### Current gaps (identified from templates)

| Issue | Severity | Location | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| Timeline chips use `text-[10px]` | Medium | `dashboard.html` | Increase to `text-xs` (12px) min |
| `sidebar-label` span inside anchor has no `aria-label` | Low | `sidebar.html` | Add `aria-label` to anchor when sidebar is collapsed (icon-only mode) |
| Alert badge span `id="alert-badge"` has no `aria-live` | Medium | `sidebar.html` | Add `aria-live="polite"` to badge container |
| Metric tile labels are `text-[11px]` uppercase | Low | `sse-metrics.html` | Acceptable at 11px uppercase — monitor, no immediate fix needed |
| Settings save buttons: no visible focus ring check | Low | `settings.html` | Verify Tailwind `focus-visible:ring` is applied |
| Mobile nav touch targets | High | `sidebar.html` | Ensure `py-2` + `text-sm` gives ≥44px; increase to `py-3` if needed |

### Keyboard navigation
- Sidebar links are standard `<a>` elements — keyboard navigable by default ✅
- Settings form inputs use standard HTML — tab order follows DOM order ✅
- New section nav bar: use `<nav>` with `aria-label="Settings sections"` ✅

### Screen reader
- Add `aria-current="page"` to active sidebar link (currently uses class only)
- Global alert indicator: wrap in `<span role="status" aria-live="polite">` ✅

### Color contrast
- `text-accent` on `metric-tile` background: verify contrast ratio ≥4.5:1 (current dark theme — likely acceptable, needs verification with actual color values from CSS)
- Warning amber on dark: verify ≥3:1 for large text (font-mono bold context)

---

## 5. Aesthetic Identity and Consistency

**Preserve:**
- Dark theme token system: `text-accent`, `text-text`, `text-text-muted`, `text-danger`, `bg-card`, `border-border` — all new elements must use only these tokens
- Lucide icon style: `stroke-width="2"`, `w-5 h-5` in nav, `w-4 h-4` in utility contexts
- Font: `font-mono` for metric values, `font-sans` (system) for labels and nav
- Spacing rhythm: `gap-3` for tile grids, `px-3 py-2` for nav items

**New elements introduced:**

| Element | Token | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| Global alert dot (header) | `bg-danger` / `bg-warning` | Consistent with existing `metric-critical` / `metric-warning` pattern |
| Settings section nav pills | `bg-card border-border` inactive, `bg-accent/20 text-accent border-accent/30` active | Matches sidebar active-link pattern |
| Micro-trend dots | `bg-green-400/40`, `bg-warning/40`, `bg-danger/40` | Matches existing threshold color system |
| Anchor jump target offset | `scroll-margin-top: 4rem` (CSS utility) | Prevents header from covering section title on jump |

**Do not introduce:**
- New color values outside existing system
- Box shadows or elevation effects not already in use
- Animation beyond existing `transition-colors duration-200`

---

## 6. UX Success Metrics

| Metric | Measurement Method | Target |
|---|---|---|
| Critical indicators above fold | Visual inspection: screenshot at 1080p and 390px viewport after delivery | 100% of 5 metric tiles visible without scroll |
| Alert discoverability | Manual test: create active alert, navigate to Settings page, verify indicator visible | Visible within 1 SSE cycle (≤2s) |
| Settings section jump | Manual test: click each anchor link, verify scroll lands at correct section header | All 6 sections reachable via anchor |
| Mobile touch targets | DevTools inspection: computed height of each nav `<a>` element | ≥44px height for all nav items |
| Tailwind build delta | Compare `web/static/css/` output size before/after | ≤5% increase |
| Test regression | `make test` | All tests green |

---

## Implementation Notes for Architect

1. **Global alert indicator:** The `alert-badge` and `alert-badge-dot` elements are managed by JS in `base.html` listening to SSE. The new header indicator should subscribe to the same event or be driven by the same JS that currently updates `#alert-badge`. No new Go handler needed.

2. **Settings section nav:** Use `<nav aria-label="Settings sections">` with anchor links `<a href="#section-backup">`. Each settings section `<div>` gets `id="section-backup"` etc. Add `scroll-margin-top` to compensate for sticky header height. Zero new routes.

3. **Metric tile micro-trend:** Requires SSE payload to include trend data or be computed client-side from the last N updates stored in a JS array. If unavailable from SSE, implement as a single state dot (current threshold only) — simpler, still additive.

4. **Mobile touch targets:** In `sidebar.html`, the nav anchor currently uses `px-3 py-2` — this gives ~36px height. Change to `px-3 py-3` or add explicit `min-h-[44px]` via Tailwind to meet the 44px minimum.
